About DealyVIP

DealyVIP focuses on cross-border business verification, establishing trust, and coordinating local assistance in restricted and emerging markets.

Our Focus

We address the core challenges of international trade in high-risk jurisdictions, specifically focusing on Türkiye, Ukraine, Russia, and Iran. We help businesses verify local entities, discover verified suppliers, and navigate complex operational environments safely.

How We Work

DealyVIP operates primarily as an informational hub and coordination service. We provide clear, direct guides for verifying partners. When remote verification is impossible or insufficient, we evaluate requests to coordinate with independent on-the-ground professionals for factory visits, meetings, and physical verification.

Operational Limitations

  • No Sanctions Evasion: We strictly follow international compliance laws. We do not invent workarounds for hard sanctions.
  • No False Guarantees: We provide structured information, but we do not guarantee the absolute safety of any transaction. We do not provide banking or escrow services.
  • Coordination Only: We act as coordinators for local assistance. Availability depends on the specific request and regional capabilities.
